definitions.gloss: windfall; unexpected good luck; lucky break
definitions.explanation: Good fortune that arrives with no effort on one's part. It is a shortening of the proverb {棚|たな}から{牡丹餅|ぼたもち} ("a botamochi falling from the shelf").

examples.japanese: ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{棚|たな}ぼただ。
{棚|たな}ぼた⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧になった。
examples.english: I ended up in first place by a stroke of luck.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棄権|きけん}→棄権：16194_kiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{棚|たな}ぼた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{転|ころ}がり{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: With my rival's withdrawal, an unexpected championship fell right into my lap.

notes:
An abbreviation of the proverb ⟦{棚|たな}から{牡丹餅|ぼたもち}→棚から牡丹餅：06196_tanakarabotamochi⟧. Often written in kana or mixed kana-kanji as {棚|たな}ぼた.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棚|たな}ぼた{式|しき}: windfall-style; effortlessly obtained
- {棚|たな}ぼた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧: a lucky win
- {棚|たな}ぼた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to hope for a lucky break

NUANCE: Can carry a faint hint of criticism, implying the result owed more to luck than to effort.
